skiInstructions.warning: Ski-on/ski-off access is snow-dependent and not guaranteed during your trip. Typically ski-on/ski-off is available from January through March.
skiInstructions.skiOn: Exit the parking lot and turn right toward the main street. Take a left onto the main street and walk a few seconds until you reach the ski-on trail. Snap into your skis there and ski down to the Sunrise Lift, which connects to Bear Mountain and the rest of the resort.
skiInstructions.skiOff: Ski down Bear Cub trail. You'll come to the Sunrise Trail on your right — don't take it, it leads all the way to the Sunrise Lift, which is a long hike back to the condo. Instead, stay to the right on Bear Cub, and a few seconds past that junction you'll see a gate on the side of the trail (pictured below). Ski around the gate onto the community trail, then follow it for a few minutes — you'll pass several condo buildings — until it reaches the road. Take your skis off there; the condo is just across the street.
skiInstructions.snowboarding: There are some flat sections on the ski-on/ski-off route, so it takes more effort to snowboard in and out than to ski. It's doable, just not always the most fun.

communityCenter.intro: As part of your stay, you have access to Sunrise Mountain Village's community center — Sunrise Commons & Sports Center. Hours and amenities shift with the season, so check the website below if you have questions, but here's what's typically available to guests:
amenities: Indoor heated pool, hot tub, sauna, and steam room during the winter season, plus a year-round outdoor hot tub and outdoor pool
A private sports center with cardio and strength training equipment
Free equipment to borrow — ice skates, snowshoes, cross-country skis and poles, sleds, and Puff Hockey gear, all from the Snowshoe Hut behind Sunrise Commons
An outdoor ice skating pond, backcountry trails, and a patio with a gas fire pit
The Hideout — a short, solar-lit walk down the Village Pond Trail to a unique nighttime spot
Seasonal hours at the on-site Sunrise Bar & Grill
